items.full: I think a flexible work schedule is more important than a high salary because it helps employees maintain a healthy work-life balance. First, flexible hours allow people to manage personal responsibilities without sacrificing their performance. For example, last year I had to take my son to a medical appointment. My manager let me start work earlier, so I completed my tasks and still arrived at the appointment on time. As a result, I felt less stressed and became more productive at work. Of course, a competitive salary matters, especially when living costs are high. However, I believe a flexible schedule improves employees' daily lives and helps them perform consistently.
